claims.explanation: Levocetirizine is a selective HRH1 antagonist, so its antiproliferative/cytotoxic effect in this screen is most plausibly explained by HRH1 expression in the cancer cells, with high HRH1 expression sensitizing and low expression protecting. Because HRH1 signaling can be coupled to proliferative and inflammatory pathways, additional sensitizing features may include TP53 pathway loss and RAS/BRAF-MAPK activation, which are enriched among the most-killed lines, while intact survival signaling such as EGFR mutation or PTEN loss without HRH1 dependence may be protective.
